title: Make the GitHub repo private
details: Step 1: merge PR #38 (All rights reserved licence). Step 2: move this board from GitHub Pages to Cloudflare Pages (a second project such as board.quando.day, optionally behind Cloudflare Access) and let the live PR status use the saved token. Step 3: replace the public 'latest' APK links with Google Play closed testing or Firebase App Distribution. Step 4: keep iOS builds on the MacBook (private repos get 2,000 free Actions minutes a month, Mac minutes count 10x). Step 5: switch the repo to private just before the public launch. quando.day already builds on Cloudflare and keeps working.
note: Licence (#38) and board move (#43) are merged. Left: replace the public APK links, then switch the repo to private.
